what_to_detect: A card's own madness replacement meets that card's move from its owner's hand to the graveyard as it is discarded, and replaces it: the card is exiled instead.
near_miss: A discarded card's move from hand to graveyard meets a replacement effect and is not replaced, so the card goes to the graveyard.
record_fields: rewrite payload.incoming: Forge's madness is an Event$ Moved replacement (Discard$ True), so the incoming event is zone_change from hand to graveyard, not card_discarded
rewrite payload.result and replaced_by (the ChangeZone to exile)
record ability: the replacing trait, the card's keyword-derived Madness line in the sidecar
rewrite_event today filters only event, result and to_zone, so without a from_zone and a keyword it would tag every graveyard-bound replacement (Rest in Peace, Leyline of the Void) as madness

what_to_detect: A resolution of an ability referring to a discarded card (a Discarded-mode trigger's TriggeredCard), resolving after that card's madness trigger put it uncast into a public zone, whose effect half acts on the card in that zone (a zone_change of it).
near_miss: The same kind of resolution where the discarded card was cast with madness, or was still in madness exile, so the reference finds no card and the effect half holds no event on it.
record_fields: resolution effect half events: zone_change whose subject is the discarded card (e.g. from graveyard)
acting line's Mode$ Discarded and Defined$ TriggeredCard through the sidecar
earlier rewrite record in the same game_id: the card's Madness replacement on its hand-to-graveyard move
madness trigger's resolution record (ChangeZone to graveyard vs spell_cast) for the same card
